citeAs: Erik F. Tjong Kim Sang and Fien De Meulder (2003). Introduction to the CoNLL-2003 Shared Task: Language-Independent Named Entity Recognition. Proceedings of CoNLL-2003.
creator: Erik F. Tjong Kim Sang, Fien De Meulder (University of Antwerp)
description: The CoNLL-2003 shared task dataset for language-independent named entity recognition, containing English and German data annotated with four types of named entities: persons, locations, organizations, and miscellaneous.
name: CoNLL-2003
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Named entity tagging of English and German training, development, and test data, was done by hand at the University of Antwerp. Mostly, MUC conventions were followed. An extra named entity category called MISC was added to denote all names which are not already in the other categories.
rai:dataCollection: The English data was taken from the Reuters Corpus. The text for the German data was taken from the ECI Multilingual Text Corpus, extracted from the German newspaper Frankfurter Rundshau.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: The English data consists of Reuters news stories between August 1996 and August 1997. The German data consists of texts from the German newspaper Frankfurter Rundshau from August to December 1992.
rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: English data: August 1996 to December 1996. German data: August 1992 to December 1992.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: For all data, a tokenizer, part-of-speech tagger, and a chunker were applied to the raw data. The English data was tagged and chunked by the memory-based MBT tagger. The German data was lemmatized, tagged and chunked by the decision tree tagger Treetagger.
rai:dataUseCases: Named entity recognition systems development and evaluation.
rai:machineAnnotationTools: Language-specific tokenizers, memory-based MBT tagger, decision tree tagger Treetagger.
